title: Backtesting High-Dimensional Expected Shortfall
abstract: arXiv:2611.13882v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Forecast evaluation increasingly uses high-dimensional predictors, but estimation and regularization of large predictive models can distort conventional backtests. This issue is particularly important for forecasting downside risk, where the signal-to-noise ratio is low. We develop out-of-sample Expected Shortfall (ES) backtests that remove the large first-order bias effects of estimating high-dimensional Value-at-Risk, ES, and the evaluation instrument. In a linear ES specification, the proposed methods are easily implemented as Double Lasso with a tail-size-adjusted score as a generated dependent variable. More generally, we characterize orthogonal ES backtesting moments, and establish oracle equivalence and valid inference under time-series dependence and repeated estimation with overlapping and expanding training windows. translated_title: 高维预期损失的回测检验
translated_abstract: 预测评估越来越多地使用高维预测变量，但大型预测模型的估计与正则化可能会扭曲传统的回测结果。这一问题在下行风险预测中尤为突出，因为下行风险预测的信噪比很低。我们开发了样本外预期损失回测方法，能够消除估计高维风险价值、预期损失以及评估工具时产生的大幅一阶偏差效应。在线性预期损失设定下，所提出的方法易于实现，只需将经尾部规模调整的得分作为生成的因变量进行双重Lasso回归即可。更一般地，我们刻画了正交化的预期损失回测矩条件，并在时间序列相依性以及使用重叠与扩展训练窗口进行重复估计的情形下，建立了预言机等价性与有效推断。模拟结果表明，传统回测方法会严重过度拒绝ES最优预测，而正交化方法能够解决这一问题。
tldr: 本文提出了消除高维估计偏差的正交化样本外预期损失回测方法（在线性设定下可通过双重Lasso实现），解决了传统回测在低信噪比的下行风险预测中严重过度拒绝最优预测的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper develops orthogonalized out-of-sample Expected Shortfall backtests that remove large first-order bias from high-dimensional estimation (implementable via Double Lasso in linear settings), resolving severe over-rejection of ES-optimal forecasts by conventional backtests.
